test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum for the period from 4 February 2023 to 18 April 2023.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Feb (4–28) = 25 days, March = 31 days, April (1–18) = 18 days

Total days = 25 + 31 + 18 = 74

SI = (2000 × 7 × 74) ÷ (100 × 365)

= 28.38

**∴ Answer = 28**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 2000

Rate = 7% per annum

Time = 4 Feb to 18 April 2023

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Days in Feb (4 to 28) = 25 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April (1 to 18) = 18 days

⇒ Total days = 25 + 31 + 18 = 74 days

⇒ Time in years = 74 ÷ 365

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 74) ÷ (100 × 365)

⇒ = 1036000 ÷ 36500

⇒ ≈ 28.38

**∴ The correct answer is 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Time Conversion

Days ÷ 365 = time in years

Month Days

Feb = 28 days (non-leap), March = 31 days
